elements.requirement: Proceedings for an offence under section 7 alleged to have been committed by a partnership must be brought in the name of the partnership and not in that of any of the partners.
elements.quote: must be brought in the name of the partnership (and not in that of any of the partners)

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 7 proceedings against a partnership, rules of court relating to the service of documents have effect as if the partnership were a body corporate.
elements.quote: rules of court relating to the service of documents have effect as if the partnership were a body corporate

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 7 proceedings against a partnership, section 33 of the Criminal Justice Act 1925 and Schedule 3 to the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980 apply as they apply in relation to a body corporate.
elements.quote: section 33 of the Criminal Justice Act 1925 and Schedule 3 to the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 7 proceedings against a partnership, section 18 of the Criminal Justice Act (Northern Ireland) 1945 and Schedule 4 to the Magistrates' Courts (Northern Ireland) Order 1981 apply as they apply in relation to a body corporate.
elements.quote: section 18 of the Criminal Justice Act (Northern Ireland) 1945 (c. 15 (N.I.)) and Schedule 4 to the Magistrates' Courts (Northern Ireland) Order 1981 (S.I. 1981/1675 (N.I.26))

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 7 proceedings against a partnership, section 70 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1995 applies as it applies in relation to a body corporate.
elements.quote: section 70 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1995

elements.requirement: A fine imposed on a partnership on its conviction for an offence under section 7 must be paid out of the partnership assets.
elements.quote: is to be paid out of the partnership assets
